title: Suffices to split the pointwise tree estimate into three terms, each bounded by a named lemma (Carleson Lemma 7.1.3)
intent: Bound the pointwise tree estimate ‖carlesonSum (t u) (exp(I·-𝒬u)·f) x‖ₑ by C7_1_3 · (maximalFunction + boundaryOperator) + nontangentialMaximalFunction by a single `suffices` that rewrites the summed kernel into three terms, then closes each term with one named same-file lemma (Lemmas 7.1.4, 7.1.5, 7.1.6), absorbing their constants into C7_1_3 via two further lemmas.
also_known_as: prove a more convenient statement first

lemma pointwise_tree_estimate (hu : u ∈ t) (hL : L ∈ 𝓛 (t u)) (hx : x ∈ L) (hx' : x' ∈ L)
    (hf : BoundedCompactSupport f) :
    ‖carlesonSum (t u) (fun y ↦ exp (.I * - 𝒬 u y) * f y) x‖ₑ ≤
    C7_1_3 a * (maximalFunction volume 𝓑 c𝓑 r𝓑 1 (approxOnCube (𝓙 (t u)) (‖f ·‖)) x' +
    t.boundaryOperator u (approxOnCube (𝓙 (t u)) (‖f ·‖)) x') +
    nontangentialMaximalFunction (𝒬 u) (approxOnCube (𝓙 (t u)) f) x'

applicability.goal_shape: A bound on a summed integral ‖∑ i ∈ σ, ∫ y, Ks i x y · (phase · f) y‖ₑ ≤ C · (maximalFunction … + boundaryOperator …) + nontangentialMaximalFunction …, where the integrand splits by algebra into a small number of terms (multiply out (exp − 1), split f = (f − g) + g) and each term is bounded by its own named lemma.
applicability.use_when: the integrand separates into terms by plain algebra, each term has an existing or separately-proved bound lemma, and the glue is only linearity of sum/integral, the triangle inequality and a few routine integrability side conditions; the per-term constants can be absorbed into the parent's constant by named constant lemmas.
applicability.avoid_when: the terms interact so they cannot be separated by norm-add and linearity (cross terms or a single dominating term needing joint control); the integrability side conditions are themselves the hard part; or there is no constant lemma to fold the per-term constants into the parent's constant, leaving the parent's bound with a sum of distinct constants.

consequences: The move turns one hard bound into three leaf lemmas plus two constant lemmas; the glue itself carries only algebra (unfold carlesonSum, factor out a unit phase, multiply out the kernel), the triangle inequality, and the integrability side conditions h1, h2, h3 that license Finset.fold_congr. Failure modes: the suffices at line 1119 asserts the sum of integrals equals the integral of the sum, which needs all three integrability facts — if any term is not integrable the exchange fails; the three terms are combined by add_le_add_three under the assumption they are independent, so a cross-term or a shared control between terms would break the combination and force the suffices to be re-posed with a different split.
